content: .{@-सत्रन्यायः@} the rule according to which an act, for which no fruit is stated directly in the injunctive text, should be held as yielding the result spoken of in the अर्थवाद text connected with it. This rule is discussed and established by Jaimini and Śabara in <ls>MS. 4. 3. 17-19</ls>.
